sources_checked: McDonald's Corporate Stories and Press Releases

events.headline: McDonald's Reports First Quarter 2026 Results
events.summary: McDonald's reported 3.8% global comparable-sales growth, 3.9% U.S. comparable-sales growth, 4% revenue growth in constant currencies and 6% operating-income growth in constant currencies for Q1 2026. The official release describes more than 45,000 locations in over 100 countries and says approximately 95% are operated by independent local business owners.

events.headline: McDonald's describes its predominantly franchised operating system
events.summary: McDonald's describes a global restaurant system predominantly operated by independent local business owners.

events.headline: Our Next Era of Growth & Productivity: Introducing McDonald's > NEXT
events.summary: McDonald's introduced the NEXT strategy to pursue growth and productivity by attracting more customers and improving restaurant unit economics.

events.headline: McDonald's 2026 outlook in the Q1 Form 10-Q
events.summary: For 2026 McDonald's expected operating margin in the mid-to-high 40% range, capital expenditures of $3.7-$3.9 billion, about 2,600 gross openings, about 2,100 net additions and free-cash-flow conversion in the low-to-mid 80% range.
